company.name: Summation
company.shortDescription: Summation delivers an AI platform that helps enterprise teams to generate insights, automate workflows, and surface strategic opportunities.
company.description:
Summation delivers a decision-grade AI platform that helps enterprise teams to generate insights, automate workflows, and surface strategic opportunities. It consolidates data across systems such as ERP, CRM, EPM, and warehouses and enables leaders to trace analytical results back to source records for auditability and confidence. The platform includes modules for finance, operations, revenue, and executive overview.

Summation supports “Verified Tasks,” which automate report generation and analysis, and “Deep Dive,” which uses AI agents to explore large numbers of business questions in parallel. During deployment, the company offers a “Forward Deployed” model in which its engineers collaborate with clients to map workflows, model key metrics, and integrate systems.
